title: Native GitHub Actions-Powered Issue-to-PR Autonomous Agent
oneLiner: Assigned directly to a GitHub issue, Copilot Coding Agent boots a secure GitHub Actions environment, explores the codebase, commits changes to a draft PR, and iterates on review comments.
evidenceDetail: The provider's own documentation describes this workflow, its requirements, and its setup steps. Zyvibe checked the linked source on 2026-11-21 and has not reproduced the workflow.
